versions.changelog:
Initial release of pilot-api-gateway.

- Exposes local APIs to the Pilot Protocol network using gateway or messaging modes.
- Allows remote Pilot agents to access local APIs without public internet exposure.
- Provides commands for starting the gateway, mapping remote APIs, and handling custom requests.
- Intended for secure integration of API-based agent services on Pilot.
- Requires pilot-protocol skill and running pilotctl daemon.
